# App Studio 42

> Open-source consumer apps with no tracking and no ads.

- Site (pt-BR): https://appstudio42.github.io/
- Site (en): https://appstudio42.github.io/en/
- GitHub org: https://github.com/appstudio42
- Sister studio (games): https://gamestudio42.github.io
- Sister studio (B2B): https://id42studio.github.io

## Product lines

### Family
Safe devices, screen time, routines, and kid-safe AI.

- KidsHome (available): Android kids launcher for phones/tablets and Amazon Fire.
  Repo: https://github.com/marcelsavegnago/KidsHome
  Download: https://github.com/marcelsavegnago/KidsHome/releases/latest
- Planned: KidsHome TV, kid-safe AI assistant, visual routines app, Fire tablet setup kit.

## Principles
Open source, privacy first (offline/local data, no analytics), free and auditable, distributed via GitHub Releases and soon F-Droid.
